question: How differences in Confidence In National Government score comparing all the regions? Evaluate the importance of governance trust on positive affects.
query: SELECT     regional_indicator,     AVG(confidence_in_national_government) AS avg_confidence,     AVG(positive_affect)                AS avg_positive_affect,     CORR(confidence_in_national_government, positive_affect) AS corr_confidence_positive FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY regional_indicator ORDER BY regional_indicator LIMIT 50;
